description: This is a shell script file that is part of a test suite for Git's log coloring and decoration features. It sets up various Git configurations, performs test cases to verify correct coloring of commit logs with decorations, replaces, and grafted commits, and compares actual output with expected results to ensure correctness.

methods.name: cmp_filtered_decorations
methods.description: Function that filters the actual output to replace commit IDs and decodes color for comparison in tests.

methods.name: remove_replace_refs
methods.description: Function that cleans up replaced references in Git to reset state after specific tests.
